title: Undo last commit (keep changes staged)
description: Undoes the most recent commit while preserving all modified files in the staging area.

title: Delete merged local git branches
content: git branch --merged | grep -v "\*" | grep -v "{{MAIN_BRANCH:main}}" | xargs -n 1 git branch -d
description: Finds all local branches already merged into the current branch and safely deletes them.

title: Find commit that deleted a specific file
description: Scans the git commit history with diff-filter=D to find which commit deleted a specified file.

title: Docker complete system prune (cleanup all unused resources)
description: Removes all stopped containers, unused networks, and build volumes.

title: Run temporary disposable container with curl & network tools
description: Spins up an ephemeral container with curl installed that attaches to host network.

title: Get IP address of a running container
description: Extracts the bridge network IP address directly from container JSON metadata.

title: Port-forward Kubernetes deployment / pod to localhost
description: Forward local port traffic directly to a Kubernetes deployment or pod.

title: Decode base64 Kubernetes Secret key
description: Extracts a specific key from a Kubernetes Secret object and decodes base64.

title: Find files modified within the last 24 hours
description: Recursively scans a target directory for regular files modified in the past 24 hours.

title: Kill process listening on a specific port
description: Finds the PID of whatever process is holding a port open and forcefully terminates it.

title: Measure HTTP latency and DNS timing breakdown with curl
content:
curl -w "@-" -o /dev/null -s "{{URL:https://api.github.com}}" << 'EOF'
  time_namelookup:  %{time_namelookup}s
     time_connect:  %{time_connect}s
  time_appconnect:  %{time_appconnect}s
 time_pretransfer:  %{time_pretransfer}s
    time_redirect:  %{time_redirect}s
time_starttransfer: %{time_starttransfer}s
                   ----------
       time_total:  %{time_total}s
EOF
description: Prints detailed millisecond timing benchmarks for DNS, TCP, TLS, and TTFB.

title: High quality video to GIF conversion with palette generation
description: Generates a custom 256-color palette pass before encoding to produce sharp, smooth GIFs.

title: Fast PostgreSQL database dump with gzip compression
description: Dumps a Postgres database using compressed custom format (-F c).

title: Generic Debounce function in TypeScript
description: Type-safe debounce function that preserves function parameter types.
